name: Gästehaus Rosemarie
beschreibung:
Sunnily situated on the Ranggen plateau, Gaestehaus Rosemarie welcomes travellers with sincere family hospitality. Bright guestrooms with balconies open up wonderful panoramic vistas across the mountains.

The Rangger Koepfl hiking and ski area and the alpine city of Innsbruck are reachable in minutes.
kurzbeschreibung: Gaestehaus Rosemarie in Ranggen offers restful tranquility and valley views near Innsbruck.
